description: This file defines CLI commands for the 'acp' module, including options for running an ACP bridge and an interactive ACP client, with functions for resolving secrets and warning about sensitive flags.

methods.name: resolveSecretOption
methods.description: Resolves secret input from direct input or file, throwing error if both are provided.

methods.name: warnSecretCliFlag
methods.description: Logs a warning that a secret flag can be exposed via process listings.

methods.name: registerAcpCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for 'acp' with options and actions for running an ACP bridge and client.
